cards.nativeTextPrompt: Title at top: 髋骨与骨盆. Under the title, a brick-red brush underline. The same coach presents two separate framed anatomical diagrams. Left: one isolated hip bone in anterior view, with three clean color regions and exact labels 髂骨, 坐骨, 耻骨; add the exact equation 髂 + 坐 + 耻 = 髋骨. Right: a complete bony pelvis in anterior view with both hip bones, sacrum and coccyx clearly colored and exact labels 左右髋骨, 骶骨, 尾骨; add the exact equation 两髋 + 骶 + 尾 = 骨盆. Clearly show the sacrum only on the pelvis side, never as part of the isolated hip bone. Bottom brick-red TIP strip, exact white text: TIP：骶骨属于骨盆，不属于单独的髋骨。

Title at top: 肩带肌：6块肌的总称. Under the title, a brick-red brush underline. Create a clean, simplified, non-photorealistic textbook anatomy card with no injury, blood, surgery, or body cut-away. Add a clear top relationship strip with exact Chinese text: 肩带肌 = 三角肌 + 冈上肌 + 冈下肌 + 小圆肌 + 大圆肌 + 肩胛下肌. The same clothed cartoon coach appears small as a presenter only. Use two large separate isolated anatomical shoulder-muscle diagrams, each with clear individual leader-line labels; never use one unlabeled red mass. Left plate is a posterior shoulder/scapula diagram with exact labels 三角肌, 冈上肌, 冈下肌, 小圆肌, 大圆肌. Right plate is an anterior scapula diagram with exact label 肩胛下肌. Add a small exact common-rule strip: 共同规律：起自锁骨、肩胛骨 → 止于肱骨. Bottom framed panel: simplified shoulder-joint diagram with exact labels 肩胛骨关节盂 and 肱骨头. Bottom brick-red TIP strip, exact white text: TIP：肩带肌不是一块肌；要记住6个成员。

Title at top: 神经元与神经纤维. Under the title, a brick-red brush underline. The same coach points to a large clean neuron diagram with a soma and nucleus, many short branching dendrites, and one long axon. Use exact labels 胞体：含细胞核; 树突：接收信息; 轴突：传出信息. In a second framed panel show a close-up cross-section and longitudinal view of one nerve fiber as an axon with myelin/glial wrapping; exact label 神经纤维：轴突 + 包裹结构. Add one small exact relationship label 神经元 = 胞体 + 突起. Bottom brick-red TIP strip, exact white text: TIP：神经元是完整细胞；神经纤维不是完整神经元。
